entries.title: Job 39:1
segments: ¶Have you knowledge of the rock-goats? or do you see the roes giving birth to their young?

entries.title: Job 39:2
segments: Is the number of their months fixed by you? or is the time when they give birth ordered by you?

entries.title: Job 39:3
segments: They are bent down, they give birth to their young, they let loose the fruit of their body.

entries.title: Job 39:4
segments: Their young ones are strong, living in the open country; they go out and do not come back again.

entries.title: Job 39:5
segments: Who has let the ass of the fields go free? or made loose the bands of the loud-voiced beast?

entries.title: Job 39:6
segments: To whom I have given the waste land for a heritage, and the salt land as a living-place.

entries.title: Job 39:7
segments: He makes sport of the noise of the town; the voice of the driver does not come to his ears;

entries.title: Job 39:8
segments: He goes looking for his grass-lands in the mountains, searching out every green thing.

entries.title: Job 39:9
segments: Will the ox of the mountains be your servant? or is his night's resting-place by your food-store?

entries.title: Job 39:10
segments: Will he be pulling your plough with cords, turning up the valleys after you?

entries.title: Job 39:11
segments: Will you put your faith in him, because his strength is great? will you give the fruit of your work into his care?

entries.title: Job 39:12
segments: Will you be looking for him to come back, and get in your seed to the crushing-floor?

entries.title: Job 39:13
segments: ¶Is the wing of the ostrich feeble, or is it because she has no feathers,

entries.title: Job 39:14
segments: That she puts her eggs on the earth, warming them in the dust,

entries.title: Job 39:15
segments: Without a thought that they may be crushed by the foot, and broken by the beasts of the field?

entries.title: Job 39:16
segments: She is cruel to her young ones, as if they were not hers; her work is to no purpose; she has no fear.

entries.title: Job 39:17
segments: For God has taken wisdom from her mind, and given her no measure of knowledge.

entries.title: Job 39:18
segments: When she is shaking her wings on high, she makes sport of the horse and of him who is seated on him.

entries.title: Job 39:19
segments: ¶Do you give strength to the horse? is it by your hand that his neck is clothed with power?

entries.title: Job 39:20
segments: Is it through you that he is shaking like a locust, in the pride of his loud-sounding breath?

entries.title: Job 39:21
segments: He is stamping with joy in the valley; he makes sport of fear.

entries.title: Job 39:22
segments: In his strength he goes out against the arms of war, turning not away from the sword.

entries.title: Job 39:23
segments: The bow is sounding against him; he sees the shining point of spear and arrow.

entries.title: Job 39:24
segments: Shaking with passion, he is biting the earth; he is not able to keep quiet at the sound of the horn;

entries.title: Job 39:25
segments: When it comes to his ears he says, Aha! He is smelling the fight from far off, and hearing the thunder of the captains, and the war-cries.

entries.title: Job 39:26
segments: ¶Is it through your knowledge that the hawk takes his flight, stretching out his wings to the south?

entries.title: Job 39:27
segments: Or is it by your orders that the eagle goes up, and makes his resting-place on high?

entries.title: Job 39:28
segments: On the rock is his house, and on the mountain-top his strong place.

entries.title: Job 39:29
segments: From there he is watching for food; his eye sees it far off.

entries.title: Job 39:30
segments: His young have blood for their drink, and where the dead bodies are, there is he to be seen.
